title: Arkret Manual Presence Preference Account Data
description: Closed decrypted plaintext shape for the principal-private ak.presence.preference account-data value. The sending client applies an unexpired preference to all of the principal's devices; services MUST NOT require its plaintext or project it into server-readable policy state.

manual_state.description: Optional pinned broadcast state. offline is expressed by stopping broadcasts and TTL expiry; invisibility is expressed by ak.presence.visibility=nobody.

status_message.description: Optional NFC status-message override, at most 256 Unicode code points. U+0009 and U+000A are the only permitted control characters; all other C0/C1 controls are rejected. NFC normalization is a semantic validation step in addition to this schema.

clears_at.description: Optional expiry instant. At or after this instant the complete preference is equivalent to absence and the sending client resumes automatic state selection without the temporary status-message override.
